Verses.VerseAr: طٰسٓ‌ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ta, Sin. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.) These are the Verses of the (Holy) Qur’an and an enlightening Book —

Verses.VerseAr: هُدًى وَبُشۡرٰى لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: A guidance and good news for (those) believers,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Who establish Prayer and pay Zakat (the Alms-due) and it is they who believe in the Hereafter (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ زَيَّـنَّا لَهُمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made their (evil) deeds appear fascinating (to them). So they wander distracted (in error).

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَهُمۡ سُوۡٓءُ الۡعَذَابِ وَهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is they for whom there is an evil punishment, and it is they who are (the greatest) losers in the Hereafter.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّكَ لَـتُلَـقَّى الۡقُرۡاٰنَ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ عَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely you are being taught (this) Qur’an from All-Wise, All-Knowing (Lord).

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰى لِاَهۡلِهٖۤ اِنِّىۡۤ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًاؕ سَاٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوۡ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Recall that incident) when Musa (Moses) said to his wife: ‘I have seen a fire (or I have perceived a flash of love and liking in the fire). Soon I will bring you some news from it (for which we have been wandering in deserts and forests since long), or I bring (you also from there) some burning brand so that you (too) may feel the burn (of its heat).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُوۡدِىَ اَنۡۢ بُوۡرِكَ مَنۡ فِى النَّارِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا ؕ وَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when he neared it, a call was given: ‘Blessed is He Who is (luminously unveiling His veil of Light) in this fire and (also) he who is around it (in the reflection of the theophanies of Allah’s Light). And Allah is Holy (and Glorified High above any resemblance and physical manifestation), the Lord of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: يٰمُوۡسٰىۤ اِنَّـهٗۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Musa [Moses]!) It is I, Allah (Unveiling My Light), Almighty, All-Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَلۡقِ عَصَاكَ‌ؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰى مُدۡبِرًا وَّلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡ‌ؕ يٰمُوۡسٰى لَا تَخَفۡ اِنِّىۡ لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ ‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Musa [Moses],) cast your staff (on the ground).’ So when (Musa (Moses) after casting the staff on the ground) saw it moving fast as if it were a serpent, he (reacting naturally) turned back running and did not (even) look back. (Allah said:) ‘O Musa (Moses), do not fear. Surely the Messengers do not fear in My Presence.

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنۡ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنًۢا بَعۡدَ سُوۡٓءٍ فَاِنِّىۡ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But whoever wrongs, then after doing evil replaces (it) with good, then I am indeed Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَدۡخِلۡ يَدَكَ فِىۡ جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍ‌ فِىۡ تِسۡعِ اٰيٰتٍ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَقَوۡمِهٖؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And put your hand into the opening of your collar. It will come out (turned) radiant white without any ill. (Both these are) of the nine Signs (of Allah). Go (with them) to Pharaoh and his people. Surely they are disobedient people.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةً قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But when Our clear and sight-giving Signs reached them, they said: ‘This is plain magic.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَحَدُوۡا بِهَا وَاسۡتَيۡقَنَـتۡهَاۤ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمًا وَّعُلُوًّا‌ؕ فَانْظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And out of vanity and wickedness, they rejected them straight away while their hearts had accepted these (Signs as true). So see how (evil) was the end of the evildoers!

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيۡمٰنَ عِلۡمًا‌ۚ وَقَالَا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ فَضَّلَنَا عَلٰى كَثِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ عِبَادِهِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We bestowed upon Dawud (David) and Sulaiman ([Solomon] extraordinary knowledge) and both said: ‘All praise be to Allah Who has exalted us above many of His believing servants.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيۡمٰنُ دَاوٗدَ‌ وَقَالَ يٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمۡنَا مَنۡطِقَ الطَّيۡرِ وَاُوۡتِيۡنَا مِنۡ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍؕ‌ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الۡفَضۡلُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Sulaiman (Solomon) succeeded Dawud (David) and said: ‘O people, we have been taught the speech of birds (as well) and we have been granted everything. No doubt, this is most obvious Grace (of Allah).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيۡمٰنَ جُنُوۡدُهٗ مِنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ وَالطَّيۡرِ فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And armies for Sulaiman (Solomon) were collected from among (all species of) the jinn, human beings and birds. So they were held on (in his service) for discipline and training.

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَاۤ اَتَوۡا عَلٰى وَادِ النَّمۡلِۙ قَالَتۡ نَمۡلَةٌ يّٰۤاَيُّهَا النَّمۡلُ ادۡخُلُوۡا مَسٰكِنَكُمۡ‌ۚ لَا يَحۡطِمَنَّكُمۡ سُلَيۡمٰنُ وَجُنُوۡدُهٗۙ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until when these (troops) reached an open field of ants, one ant said: ‘O ants, enter your dwellings, lest Sulaiman (Solomon) and his troops crush you while they remain just unaware.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّنۡ قَوۡلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ اَوۡزِعۡنِىۡۤ اَنۡ اَشۡكُرَ نِعۡمَتَكَ الَّتِىۡۤ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلٰى وَالِدَىَّ وَاَنۡ اَعۡمَلَ صَالِحًـا تَرۡضٰٮهُ وَاَدۡخِلۡنِىۡ بِرَحۡمَتِكَ فِىۡ عِبَادِكَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So he (Sulaiman [Solomon]) smiled, feeling amused at the ant’s words, and submitted: ‘O Lord, keep me by Your bestowal firm on it that I remain ever-thankful for Your favour which You have conferred on me and on my parents, and I do such pious deeds as You are pleased with, and admit me by Your mercy among your pious slaves enjoying exceptional nearness to You.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيۡرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَاۤ اَرَى الۡهُدۡهُدَ‌ۖ اَمۡ كَانَ مِنَ الۡغَآٮِٕبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Sulaiman (Solomon) inspected the birds and said: ‘How is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Or has he (really) vanished?

Verses.VerseAr: لَاُعَذِّبَـنَّهٗ عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًا اَوۡ لَاَاذۡبَحَنَّهٗۤ اَوۡ لَيَاۡتِيَنِّىۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: I will certainly award him severe punishment (for being absent without leave) or will certainly slaughter him, or he will bring me a sound plea (of being not guilty).’

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَكَثَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيۡدٍ فَقَالَ اَحَطْتُ بِمَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهٖ وَجِئۡتُكَ مِنۡ سَبَاٍۭ بِنَبَاٍ يَّقِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It was only for a little while that he stayed (outside), then he (appeared and) said: ‘I have come to know a thing that is (perhaps) not in your knowledge, and I have brought you from (the land of) Saba (Sheba) a sure and true piece of news.

Words.MeaningEn: and I have come to you

Verses.VerseAr: اِنِّىۡ وَجَدتُّ امۡرَاَةً تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَاُوۡتِيَتۡ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ وَّلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: I have found (there) a woman who is ruling over them (i.e. the citizens of the land of Saba [Sheba]), and she has been given everything (of possession and authority), and she has a great throne.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَدْتُّهَا وَقَوۡمَهَا يَسۡجُدُوۡنَ لِلشَّمۡسِ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَصَدَّهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ فَهُمۡ لَا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: I found her and her people prostrating themselves before the sun instead of Allah. And Satan has made their (evil) deeds highly fascinating for them and has hindered them from the path (of the Oneness of Allah). So they are not getting guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَّا يَسۡجُدُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ يُخۡرِجُ الۡخَبۡءَ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُخۡفُوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They are hindered) so that they do not fall in prostration before the Presence of Allah, Who brings forth (i.e. unveils) the (realities and forms of matter) hidden in the heavens and the earth and knows (all) those things which you hide and which you disclose.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ الۡعَرۡشِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ ۩‏
Verses.VerseEn: There is none worthy of worship except Allah. He alone is the Master of the Supreme Throne of Authority.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ سَنَـنۡظُرُ اَصَدَقۡتَ اَمۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Sulaiman [Solomon]) said: ‘We see right now whether you speak the truth or you are of the liars.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡهَب بِّكِتٰبِىۡ هٰذَا فَاَلۡقِهۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَانْظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Go with this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then withdraw from them and see what they turn to.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ يٰۤاَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اِنِّىۡۤ اُلۡقِىَ اِلَىَّ كِتٰبٌ كَرِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Queen) said: ‘O chiefs, a noble letter has been delivered to me.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ سُلَيۡمٰنَ وَاِنَّهٗ بِسۡمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِيۡمِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That (letter) has indeed (come) from Sulaiman (Solomon), and that begins with the Name of Allah, Who is Most Kind, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَّا تَعۡلُوۡا عَلَىَّ وَاۡتُوۡنِىۡ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Its contents read:) ‘Do not (strive to) rise above me and come to me in submission.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ يٰۤاَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اَفۡتُوۡنِىۡ فِىۡۤ اَمۡرِىۡ‌ۚ مَا كُنۡتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمۡرًا حَتّٰى تَشۡهَدُوۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Queen) said: ‘O courtiers, advise me in this matter. I do not make a final decision on any matter until you come to me and state your opinions (for or against the matter).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا نَحۡنُ اُولُوۡا قُوَّةٍ وَّاُولُوۡا بَاۡسٍ شَدِيۡدٍ  ۙ وَّالۡاَمۡرُ اِلَيۡكِ فَانْظُرِىۡ مَاذَا تَاۡمُرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘We are powerful and great warriors but the command is your prerogative. So consider (yourself) what command you should give.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَتۡ اِنَّ الۡمُلُوۡكَ اِذَا دَخَلُوۡا قَرۡيَةً اَفۡسَدُوۡهَا وَجَعَلُوۡۤا اَعِزَّةَ اَهۡلِهَاۤ اَذِلَّةً ‌ۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The Queen) said: ‘No doubt when kings enter a town, they destroy it and disgrace and humiliate its elite citizens. And these (people) too will do the same.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنِّىۡ مُرۡسِلَةٌ اِلَيۡهِمۡ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرۡجِعُ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely I am sending him some gifts and see what reply the messengers bring back.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ قَالَ اَتُمِدُّوۡنَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَاۤ اٰتٰٮنۦَ اللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّاۤ اٰتٰٮكُمۡ‌ۚ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمۡ تَفۡرَحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when that (messenger) came to Sulaiman (Solomon he) said (to him [i.e. the messenger]): ‘Do you want to help me with wealth, whereas what Allah has given me is better than this (wealth) which He has given you? It is rather you who take pleasure (and) pride in your gifts.

Verses.VerseAr: اِرۡجِعۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَلَنَاۡتِيَنَّهُمۡ بِجُنُوۡدٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُمۡ بِهَا وَلَـنُخۡرِجَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۡهَاۤ اَذِلَّةً وَّهُمۡ صٰغِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So go back to them (with your gifts). We will come with such troops (to invade) them they will not have (the power) to fight back, and, humiliating them, we shall drive them out from there in such a plight that they will be dishonoured (becoming prisoners).’

Words.MeaningEn: surely, we will come to them
and surely, we will drive them out

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰۤاَيُّهَا الۡمَلَؤُا اَيُّكُمۡ يَاۡتِيۡنِىۡ بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّاۡتُوۡنِىۡ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Sulaiman (Solomon) said: ‘O courtiers, which of you can bring me the throne (of the Queen) before they come to me in submission?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ عِفۡرِيۡتٌ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ اَنَا اٰتِيۡكَ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمَ مِنۡ مَّقَامِكَ‌ۚ وَاِنِّىۡ عَلَيۡهِ لَـقَوِىٌّ اَمِيۡنٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: One mighty jinn submitted: ‘I can bring it to you before you rise from your seat. And I am indeed energetic (enough) and trustworthy (to bring it).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ الَّذِىۡ عِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمٌ مِّنَ الۡـكِتٰبِ اَنَا اٰتِيۡكَ بِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّرۡتَدَّ اِلَيۡكَ طَرۡفُكَ‌ؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسۡتَقِرًّا عِنۡدَهٗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنۡ فَضۡلِ رَبِّىۡ‌ۖ لِيَبۡلُوَنِىۡٓ ءَاَشۡكُرُ اَمۡ اَكۡفُرُ‌ؕ وَمَنۡ شَكَرَ فَاِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهٖ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ رَبِّىۡ غَنِىٌّ كَرِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then the one who had some knowledge of the (heavenly) Book submitted: ‘I can bring it to you before your vision turns back to you (i.e. even before the twinkling of an eye). So, when (Sulaiman [Solomon]) saw it (the throne) placed before him, he said: ‘This is by the Grace of my Lord so that He may put me to the test whether I thank (Him) or not. And he who thanks (Allah) his gratitude is for the good of his own self, and he who is ungrateful surely my Lord is Self-Sufficient, Most Generous.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ نَكِّرُوۡا لَهَا عَرۡشَهَا نَـنۡظُرۡ اَتَهۡتَدِىۡۤ اَمۡ تَكُوۡنُ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Sulaiman (Solomon) said: ‘(To test the Queen,) change the display and appearance of her throne. We shall see whether she gets some clue (to recognize it) or proves to be of those who do not have quick reflexes.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ قِيۡلَ اَهٰكَذَا عَرۡشُكِ‌ؕ قَالَتۡ كَاَنَّهٗ هُوَ‌ۚ وَاُوۡتِيۡنَا الۡعِلۡمَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then when she (the Queen) came she was asked: ‘Is your throne like this?’ She said: ‘It looks as if it is the same and we have already known (the Truth of Sulaiman’s [Solomon’s] Prophethood) and we have become Muslims.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتۡ تَّعۡبُدُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّهَا كَانَتۡ مِنۡ قَوۡمٍ كٰفِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the (false god) she worshipped besides Allah prevented her (the Queen from accepting the Truth before this). No doubt she was of a disbelieving people.

Verses.VerseAr: قِيۡلَ لَهَا ادۡخُلِىۡ الصَّرۡحَ‌ۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُـجَّةً وَّكَشَفَتۡ عَنۡ سَاقَيۡهَا‌ؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ صَرۡحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّنۡ قَوَارِيۡرَ‌  ؕ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِىۡ وَاَسۡلَمۡتُ مَعَ سُلَيۡمٰنَ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It was said to her (the Queen): ‘Enter the compound of the palace (beneath which were flowing waves of bluish water).’ So when the Queen saw that (elegant crystal floor) she thought it was a deep pool. And (pulling up her skirt) she uncovered her lower legs. Sulaiman (Solomon) said: ‘This is the compound of the palace paved with crystal slabs.’ The Queen submitted: ‘O my Lord, (I was deluded in like manner.) Surely I wronged my soul. And now along with Sulaiman (Solomon), I submit to Allah, Who is the Lord of all the worlds.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَاۤ اِلٰى ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًا اَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ فَرِيۡقٰنِ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We sent to the people of Thamud their (kinship) brother Salih (as a Messenger:) ‘Worship Allah.’ Then they became two parties disputing with each other.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ لِمَ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبۡلَ الۡحَسَنَةِ‌‌ۚ لَوۡلَا تَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡنَ اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Salih said: ‘O my people, why do you hasten the evil (i.e. torment) before the good (i.e. mercy)? Why do you not ask for forgiveness from Allah so that you are shown mercy?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا اطَّيَّرۡنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنۡ مَّعَكَ‌ؕ قَالَ طٰٓٮِٕرُكُمۡ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ‌ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تُفۡتَـنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘You have caused us misfortune and so have your companions.’ (Salih) said: ‘(The cause of) your misfortune is (written) with Allah; you people have rather been put to trial.’

Words.MeaningEn: We consider you a bad omen

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَانَ فِىۡ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٍ يُّفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there were in the city (of the people of Thamud) nine prominent leaders (leading their respective parties) who used to spread destructive activities in the land and would not do constructive works.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا تَقَاسَمُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ لَـنُبَيِّتَـنَّهٗ وَاَهۡلَهٗ ثُمَّ لَـنَقُوۡلَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهٖ مَا شَهِدۡنَا مَهۡلِكَ اَهۡلِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (These leaders) said: ‘Vow among yourselves by swearing in the Name of Allah that we will certainly launch a murder attack against Salih and his family at night and will then tell their heirs that we were not present on the occasion of their murder. And surely we are telling the truth.’

Words.MeaningEn: surely, we will attack him by night

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا وَّمَكَرۡنَا مَكۡرًا وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They worked out a plan in secret and We (also) devised a secret scheme (to foil that), and they did not get a hint of it.

Verses.VerseAr: فَانْظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡۙ اَنَّا دَمَّرۡنٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: See then what was the end of their (wicked) plan! Surely We destroyed those (leaders) and their entire people altogether.

Verses.VerseAr: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوۡتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوۡا‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاَيَةً لِّـقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So these are their houses lying ruined, for they committed oppression and injustice. No doubt there is a Sign (of Warning) in it for those who have knowledge.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡجَيۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We delivered those who believed and became Godfearing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلُوۡطًا اِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهٖۤ اَتَاۡتُوۡنَ الۡـفَاحِشَةَ وَاَنۡـتُمۡ تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (recall) Lut (Lot) when he said to his people: ‘Do you commit indecency while you see (as well)?

Verses.VerseAr: اَٮِٕنَّكُمۡ لَـتَاۡتُوۡنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهۡوَةً مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ النِّسَآءِ‌ؕ بَلۡ اَنۡـتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do you approach men rather than women to satisfy your sexual desire? The truth is that you are ignorant people.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوۡمِهٖۤ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ قَالُـوۡۤا اَخۡرِجُوۡۤا اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ مِّنۡ قَرۡيَتِكُمۡ‌ۚ اِنَّهُمۡ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The only answer of his people was that they said: ‘Drive out the family of Lut (Lot) from your town; they claim to be very pious.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰهُ وَاَهۡلَهٗۤ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرۡنٰهَا مِنَ الۡغٰبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We delivered Lut (Lot) and his family except his wife, for We destined her to be among those who stayed behind (for torment).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّطَرًا‌ۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We heavily rained upon them (stones). So evil was the rain (of stones) upon those people who were stressed with horror.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ وَسَلٰمٌ عَلٰى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِيۡنَ اصۡطَفٰىؕ اٰۤللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ اَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘All praise be to Allah and peace be upon His Servants whom He has Chosen (and Exalted). Is Allah better or those (false gods) that these people associate (with Him)?’

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَاَنۡزَلَ لَـكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً‌ۚ فَاَنۡۢبَتۡنَا بِهٖ حَدَآٮِٕقَ ذَاتَ بَهۡجَةٍ‌ۚ مَّا كَانَ لَـكُمۡ اَنۡ تُـنۡۢبِتُوۡا شَجَرَهَاؕ ءَاِلٰـهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ يَّعۡدِلُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, Who has created the heavens and the earth and poured down water for you from the atmosphere in the sky? Then with that (water) We brought forth fresh and beautiful gardens. It was not possible for you to grow plants in these (gardens). Is there any (other) God besides Allah? In fact, they are the people who are turning away (from the path of Truth).

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ جَعَلَ الۡاَرۡضَ قَرَارًا وَّجَعَلَ خِلٰلَهَاۤ اَنۡهٰرًا وَّجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ حَاجِزًا‌ؕ ءَاِلٰـهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or, Who made the earth a dwelling place and made rivers amid it and made for it huge mountains and put a barrier between the two seas (of salt and sweet waters)? Is there any (other) God besides Allah? But most of these (disbelievers) do not have knowledge.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ يُّجِيۡبُ الۡمُضۡطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكۡشِفُ السُّوۡٓءَ وَيَجۡعَلُكُمۡ خُلَفَآءَ الۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ ءَاِلٰـهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ قَلِيۡلاً مَّا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or, Who grants the supplication of the anxiety-stricken caller when he calls upon Him and Who removes the trouble and makes you successors and inheritors (of the predecessors) in the earth? Is there any (other) God besides Allah? You people accept advice in the least.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡكُمۡ فِىۡ ظُلُمٰتِ الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِ وَمَنۡ يُّرۡسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَىۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖؕ ءَاِلٰـهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ تَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or, Who guides you in the darkness of land and sea and sends winds as good news before (the rain of) His Mercy? Is there any (other) God besides Allah? Exalted is Allah High above (the false gods) which they associate with Him.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّنۡ يَّبۡدَؤُا الۡخَـلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ وَمَنۡ يَّرۡزُقُكُمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ ءَاِلٰـهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Well, Who originates creation and shall repeat the same (process of creation) and Who grants you sustenance from the heavens and the earth? Is there any (other) God besides Allah? Say: ‘(O polytheists,) bring your proof if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُل لَّا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ الۡغَيۡبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ‌ؕ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ اَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Those who are in the heavens and the earth do not have the knowledge of the unseen (by themselves) except Allah (Who is Self-Knowing), nor do they know when they will be raised up (alive again).’

Verses.VerseAr: بَلِ ادّٰرَكَ عِلۡمُهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡاٰخِرَةِ‌ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِىۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهَا‌ بَلۡ هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا عَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The truth is that their knowledge about the Hereafter terminated after reaching (its) limit but they are just (caught) in doubt about it. Nay, they are blind to its (exact knowledge).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا تُرٰبًا وَّاٰبَآؤُنَاۤ اَٮِٕنَّا لَمُخۡرَجُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers say: ‘When we and our fathers become dust (after death), shall we be brought forth (from graves alive)?

Verses.VerseAr: لَـقَدۡ وُعِدۡنَا هٰذَا نَحۡنُ وَاٰبَآؤُنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُۙ اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: In fact we and, before this, our ancestors (too) have been promised this. These are but stories fabricated by the foregoing people.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَانْظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Travel in the land and see how was the end of the evildoers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُنۡ فِىۡ ضَيۡقٍ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Esteemed Beloved,) do not grieve (over what they say), nor (undergo) distress at the deceitful and treacherous activities which they are carrying out.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘(Reply) when this promise (of the Last Day) will come true if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ عَسٰٓى اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ رَدِفَ لَـكُمۡ بَعۡضُ الَّذِىۡ تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘It is not far from possible that a part of that (torment) which you seek to hasten has nearly reached you.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely your Lord is Gracious to the people but most of them do not give thanks.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَـعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوۡرُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And certainly your Lord knows well what their breasts hide and also what they make known.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا مِنۡ غَآٮِٕبَةٍ فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا فِىۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there is nothing hidden in the heavens and the earth but is recorded in a Clear Book (al-Lawh al-Mahfuz).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ يَقُصُّ عَلٰى بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرآءِيۡلَ اَكۡثَرَ الَّذِىۡ هُمۡ فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely this Qur’an expounds to the Children of Israel most of the things in which they differ.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّهٗ لَهُدًى وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily it is Guidance and Mercy for the believers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِىۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِحُكۡمِهٖ‌ۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ ۙ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And verily your Lord will judge between these (believers and disbelievers) by His Command (of Justice). And He is Almighty, All-Knowing.

Verses.VerseAr: فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اِنَّكَ عَلَى الۡحَـقِّ الۡمُبِيۡنِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So put your trust in Allah. Surely you are (firm and fixed) on the Evident Truth.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ الۡمَوۡتٰى وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Beloved!) Surely you neither make the dead (i.e. the disbelievers deprived of the vitality of faith) hear your call nor the deaf (i.e. deprived of hearing the call of Truth) while they are getting away (from you) turning their backs.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِهٰدِىۡ الۡعُمۡىِ عَنۡ ضَلٰلَتِهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنۡ تُسۡمِعُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nor can you guide the blind (of heart, rescuing them) from their wrong path. (In fact) you make hear only those who (accepting your call) believe in Our Revelations. So it is they who are Muslims (and only they deserve to be called alive).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا وَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةً مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمۡۙ اَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا لَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when the time to execute Our Command (of torment) against them comes, We shall bring out for them from the earth a beast who will converse with them because people do not place certitude in Our Signs.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ فَوۡجًا مِّمَّنۡ يُّكَذِّبُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Day when We shall gather out of every Umma (Community) a party of those who used to reject Our Revelations, they will be stopped (from the front in order that they all move together).

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءُوۡ قَالَ اَكَذَّبۡتُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِىۡ وَلَمۡ تُحِيۡطُوۡا بِهَا عِلۡمًا اَمَّاذَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Till when they all reach (the accountability post), it will be said: ‘Did you reject My Revelations (without meditating on them), whereas you could not thoroughly understand them with (your inadequate) knowledge? Or (tell yourselves) what else was (the reason) that you used to (belie the Truth).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَوَقَعَ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِمَا ظَلَمُوۡا فَهُمۡ لَا يَنۡطِقُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (Our) promise against them has been fulfilled because they continued doing injustice. So they will not be able to say anything (in reply).

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا الَّيۡلَ لِيَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًا‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّـقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not seen that We made the night for them so that they may rest in it and the day sight-giving (to oversee the affairs of life and to make things visible and perceptible). Indeed there are Signs in it for those who believe.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يُنۡفَخُ فِىۡ الصُّوۡرِ فَفَزِعَ مَنۡ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنۡ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ وَكُلٌّ اَتَوۡهُ دٰخِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And on the Day when the trumpet is blown, then (all) those in the heavens and in the earth will be terrified except those whom Allah pleases (will not worry). And all will appear before His Presence submissively.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرَى الۡجِبَالَ تَحۡسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَّهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ‌ؕ صُنۡعَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِىۡۤ اَتۡقَنَ كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ خَبِيۡرٌۢ بِمَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O man,) you will see the mountains and think them firmly fixed whereas they will be flying like the passing of clouds. (This) is the work of Allah, Who has made everything strong and stable (with Wisdom and Strategy). Surely He is Well-Aware of all (the works) that you do.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهَا‌ۚ وَهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَزَعٍ يَّوۡمَٮِٕذٍ اٰمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever brings good (that Day), for him (the reward) will be better than that and they will be peaceful and secure against terror that Day.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ فِىۡ النَّارِؕ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whoever brings evil shall be thrown prone into the Fire (of Hell). So you will be rewarded only for what you used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَاۤ اُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَعۡبُدَ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الۡبَلۡدَةِ الَّذِىۡ حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهٗ كُلُّ شَىۡءٍ‌ وَّاُمِرۡتُ اَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Say to them:) ‘I have been commanded only to worship the Lord of this city (Makka), Who has made it Holy and Sacred, and everything belongs to Him alone. And I have (also) been commanded to be of those who submit wholly (to Allah),

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَنۡ اَتۡلُوَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ‌ۚ فَمَنِ اهۡتَدٰى فَاِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِىۡ لِنَفۡسِهٖ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ ضَلَّ فَقُلۡ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُنۡذِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that I keep reciting the Qur’an. So whoever accepts Guidance takes the straight path only for his own benefit and (to him) who wanders on in error, say: ‘I am only of the Warners.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُلِ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ سَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ فَتَعۡرِفُوۡنَهَا‌ؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And say: ‘All praise belongs to Allah alone. Soon He will show you His Signs and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do.’
